description: Post a comment on your own submission for an assignment, optionally with files attached. Your instructor sees it. To attach a file, upload it first with upload_comment_attachment. [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: call it once for a preview and a confirm_token, show the preview to the user, and only if they say yes call it again with the same arguments, confirm=true and that confirm_token. Apps that can ask the user directly show a confirmation instead.]

assignment_id.description: Assignment ID (numeric string). Get it from list_assignments or list_upcoming_assignments.

comment.description: Comment text, visible to your instructor.

confirm.description: Set to true together with confirm_token to carry out a request you already previewed.

confirm_token.description: The one-time token from the preview. Only use it after the user has said yes.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

file_ids.description: Optional file IDs returned by upload_comment_attachment, to attach to this comment.

name: post_submission_comment
title: Post Submission Comment
